source.name: Wanted Design System Community
source.purpose: Queue the exact Figma node-level reads required before LDS can claim complete WDS coverage parity.

externalAccess.method: Figma MCP metadata, screenshot, and design-context reads
externalAccess.notes: Live Figma MCP metadata reads are still blocked by the Starter plan call limit. The checked-in WDS .fig export has been decoded locally and now records text, section labels, variant-like symbol names, dimensions, and visual samples, but it does not prove a newer live Figma URL is unchanged.

statusLegend.source-node-known: The WDS source node is known and ready for metadata or design-context extraction.
statusLegend.confirmed-covered: The source node has already been checked directly and corresponding LDS coverage exists.
statusLegend.theme-override-review: The WDS source role is intentionally replaced by LK theme assets, but structural usage still needs review.
statusLegend.local-evidence-pending-figma: LDS evidence exists, but exact WDS child nodes, variants, or examples are not yet verified.

closureCriteria: Compare the imported WDS icon folder and assets/icons/manifest.json against the Figma source node inventory.
Verify icon size, stroke/fill treatment, disabled/secondary coloring, and grid alignment.
Classify any missing WDS glyph as direct gap, LK rename, or intentionally excluded icon.
Verify WDS logo sizing, clear-space, lockup, and contrast guidance.
Record which WDS logo rules are retained structurally and which are replaced by LK ROBOTICS brand rules.
Ensure LK brand stories do not imply visual parity with the WDS logo asset.
Extract exact WDS Basic child sections and map color, typography, line, fill, opacity, and radius examples one by one.
Confirm LK color overrides only change values, not semantic role names or hierarchy.
Identify any Basic subsection that is not represented in FOUNDATION_AUDIT.json.
Extract all WDS spacing subsections beyond the confirmed mobile status and bottom example.
Verify base scale, component padding, section gap, responsive gutter, and safe-area behavior.
Ensure every WDS spacing primitive has either an LDS token or an explicit LK override note.
Keep mobile status bar, home indicator, bottom bar, and bottom action safe-area spacing represented in LDS.
Recheck this row only if WDS updates the source node or LDS spacing tokens change.
Extract WDS radius, shadow, divider, blur, overlay, and decorative treatment examples.
Map each effect to tokens/effects.css or an explicit visual-token exception.
Verify no component-specific decorative value silently overrides WDS Decorate guidance.
Local PDF confirms Essential system bars and Divider variants; verify exact dimensions and source variants when Figma reads resume.
Extract remaining WDS layout child sections and examples.
Verify page shell, stack, alignment, grid, scroll, and accessibility behavior against LDS stories.
Keep PageHeader classified as product extension unless WDS has a matching component contract.
Local PDF confirms Action Area, Button, Text Button, Icon Button, Chip, and Toggle Icon.
Extract any remaining WDS Action child sections.
Map each child to ActionArea, Button, TextButton, IconButton, Chip, ToggleIcon, ButtonGroup, SplitButton, Fab, SocialButton, or an explicit extension boundary.
Verify variant, size, icon slot, loading, disabled, focus, and dark-surface states.

Use the source screenshot and local state matrices as section-level evidence for Textinput, Select, Control, Segmented Control, Check Mark, Switch, and Framed Style, but do not close parity until exact Figma child nodes are read.
Extract WDS input, textarea, select, checkbox, radio, check mark, switch, segmented control, framed style, chip, and card-selection child nodes.
Verify Textinput field status, size, height, icon slot, right-button slot, autocomplete, active/focus/disabled, helper/required/description, and resource examples.
Verify Select render mode, active/open, focus, status, disabled, heading, required, description, overflow, leading icon, preview, and resource examples.
Verify Control size, checked/unchecked/indeterminate, tight, label on/off, disabled, customization, interaction, and resource examples across Checkbox, Radio, Check Mark, and Switch.
Verify Segmented Control solid/outlined variants, small/medium/large sizes, icon variants, inactive/active/focus/active-focus compositions, and resource examples.
Verify Framed Style selected, disabled, normal/negative status, interaction normal/hovered/focused, radius, padding, shadow, and composed resource examples.
Classify DateTime, ColorSwatch, PinInput, and FileUpload as product extensions unless WDS source contains matching nodes.
Extract WDS card, list cell, text, media, badge/tag, avatar, thumbnail, and disclosure examples.

Verify the user-provided Avatar PDF matrix for person/company/academy variants, size, placeholder, interaction, pushBadge, customize, and Avatar Group trailingContent against exact Figma child-node properties.
Verify the user-provided Avatar Resource placeholder and deactivate assets against exact Figma child-node properties.

Verify the user-provided Content Card PDF for thumbnailOverlay, caption, toggleIcon, extraCaption, topContent, bottomContent, skeleton, List Card leading/trailing content, width, and thumbnailAspectRatio.
Verify the user-provided Content Badge PDF for variant, icon, size, color, and accent customization axes.
Verify the user-provided Thumbnail PDF for all ratio presets plus radius and border toggles.
Verify the user-provided List Cell PDF for verticalPadding, verticalAlign, fillWidth, textEllipsis, divider, chevron, selected, disabled, interaction, leadingContent, and trailingContent axes.
Verify card/list density, thumbnail placement, action slots, title/subtitle/meta structure, and selected states.
Keep ProductCard, statistics cards, and writing editor classified as LK Product Extension unless WDS has an equivalent source contract.
Local PDF confirms Wanted loading, Circular loading, Skeleton Text length, Skeleton align, Rectangle customization, and Circle customization axes.
Extract WDS skeleton, spinner/loading, circular, and progress examples.
Verify size, determinate/indeterminate, label, empty/loading pairing, and reduced-motion behavior.
Map Meter to WDS only if the source includes the same semantic role; otherwise keep as product extension.

Local PDFs confirm Category variant/size/padding/verticalPadding/scroll, Tab resize/size/padding/trailingIconButton/scroll, Page Indicator counter/size/alternative, and Pagination extended/compact/minimize plus slot controls.
Extract WDS top bar, tab/category, pagination, menu, footer, side navigation, and stepper examples.
Verify hover-collapse behavior, mobile variants, route/selected states, badges, counters, and disabled/focus states.
Ensure LDS side navigation behavior follows WDS interaction guidance instead of an invented explicit close pattern.
Local PDFs confirm Toast severity/icon axes, Snackbar heading/description/icon/close/action axes, and Alert iOS/Android/web platform treatments.
Extract WDS alert, toast, snackbar, modal, confirm, empty, banner, callout, and notification examples.
Verify icon size alignment, severity color, title/body/action structure, close action, and timeout/persistent behavior.
Keep Snackbar represented as a separate LDS component/story unless WDS node-level reads prove it should collapse into Toast.
Local PDFs confirm Tooltip size/position/arrow alignment/shortcut axes and Menu normal/radio/checkbox/action-area/scroll/item-state axes.
Extract the three WDS Presentation child sections and exact component names.
Verify tooltip, menu, overlay, dimmer, anchored placement, keyboard/focus, and dismissal behavior.
Keep Lightbox and CommandPalette classified as product extensions unless WDS contains equivalent source nodes.
